takes.text: Forty years on the docks and they finished it with a letter. Mickey gave me the door. I don't forget that.

takes.text: You want to stand there, son, you stand where I can see you. That's all I ask.
takes.heard: You want to stand there son, you stand where I can see you. That's all I ask.

takes.text: Nobody's asked me yet. When they do, I'll tell them the truth, and I'll tell you first.
